host.description: Hostname for shorthand expansion (schema v4+), hostname only - no protocol or slashes. Defaults to github.com.

owner.description: Default owner for shorthand repository entries (schema v4+). A string entry "repo" or "owner/repo" expands to https://<host>/<owner>/<name> and auto-composes as a sub-workspace when its checkout contains a workspace manifest.

secretsDirectory.description: Gitignored directory holding per-repository local config files synced by `wspace env sync` (renamed from vaultDirectory in schema v4; default "secrets").

anyOf.description: Shorthand repository name: either "repo" (expands against the manifest's owner) or "owner/repo" (expands against the manifest's host with an inline owner). The result auto-composes when the checkout contains a workspace manifest (schema v4+).

name.description: Local checkout label (a single path segment under repositoriesDirectory): no slashes or path traversal; must be unique across the composed tree.

owner.description: Expand this entry against the manifest's host instead of providing a url: https://<host>/<owner>/<name>. Mutually exclusive with url. The result auto-composes like bare strings.

url.description: Clone URL for any Git host. Mutually exclusive with owner. Entries carrying an explicit url never auto-compose.
